Created by `CreateDocumentTypeFolders`. Sort every new document type into one of them: - **Page** — a document that renders. May use compositions. - **Block** — element for block list/grid. Renders. Never used as a composition. - **Composition** — element only composed onto others. Never rendered, never pickable. Never put real content behind a composition (removing a composition permanently deletes its content). - **Data** — element that never renders (settings, events, people). - **Repository** — document that never renders; a container/root node. For a single site, assign it the domain `/`; for several, give each its own hostname.
